snippet.title: Galaxy on Fire 2 - Supernova by FISHLABS - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Face obliteration in the fires of a dying star in Supernova, the upcoming add-on for Fishlabs' award-winning sci-fi epic Galaxy on Fire 2! For more info, check out http://www.galaxyonfire.com. 

Supernova will blaze onto all Apple devices (iPhone, iPad, iPod touch, Mac) in September 2012. Prepare yourselves for an action-packed open space shooter that will blow your mind and melt your screen!

A gripping new storyline that exceeds the combined storylines of the main game Galaxy on Fire 2 and the first add-on Valkyrie in size and intensity will keep you on the edge of your seat! Tons of red-hot content and features such as new space ships, star systems, blue prints, characters, weapon systems, mission types, gameplay modes and power-ups as well as enhanced graphics and special effects will keep you hooked for hours on end. Take over the role of Keith T. Maxwell once again and face your biggest challenge to date!

Keep an eye out for smoke signs on the App Store - because Supernova's already heating up!
